Map code entry 0 (action 0): a land mine going off on the steel floor. JMP $044C, screen_shake: sound 0 and twelve random jolts of the screen, the same as when explosives are Used (item effect 1). It returns with the carry that random_byte's last addition left ($24EC), so whether the game redraws the view ($8872) is left to chance; the record's change follows either way ($8840). Action squares 0-8 run it (records $3BEC-$3C04). These are the hidden mines, in nine groups: 0 at (28,10)-(28,12), 1 at (26,9)-(26,11), 2 at (24,11) and (24,12), 3 at (24,9) and (25,9), 4 at (22,9) and (22,10), 5 at (22,12), 6 at (20,10), (21,10) and (20,12), 7 at (18,10) and (18,11), and 8 at (17,10) and (17,11). Record n's change is remote change 18 + n. It empties that group's spotting squares (message square 0, no message) and makes the party's square check square 3: "You step on a land mine and set it off." Every conscious member is tested against skill 37, the marker only Dan Citrine's record carries (map 6, $44A0 +$BA), so each of the others, and Dan on an open 2d6 roll under 5 (engine $0C70-$0C75), loses 12d6 CON. Remote change 17 then leaves a crater, tile square 1 ("You stumble on a small crater."). The spotting squares are check squares 2 and 4-11 beside the groups: (29,9)-(29,12), (27,9), (25,12), (25,10), (23,10), (23,11), (21,11), (19,11), and (18,9) with (17,12). Each says "The steel sheets are slippery." When any member passes Perception 3 to 6, "You spot some land mines." and remote changes 2-10 show the group as tile square 2 (tile 44). A shown mine stepped on becomes action square 0, whatever its group, and goes off the same way through remote change 18. Remote change 20, group 2's, empties (25,11), already message square 0, not group 2's spotting square (25,12), which stays.
